doc.intent: Readable AGB-001 reflected color response, LCD persistence and the subpixel grid, one grid cell per game pixel
doc.core_options: The default variant's NSO colour matrix pins mGBA's own colour correction off (mGBA's default too), so GBA colours pass one matrix; the AGB-001 variant has no matrix and, like shaders off, keeps mGBA's setting. The launcher writes these into the core options file each launch.
